scope: Full already known Urban01 night development recording; no model/quality change and no final-test use

history: Same frozen 128x20Hz causal radar features and one-second actual-sample anchor; one cold start at first ground radar endpoint; never reset at reporting segments

quality_rule: Unchanged absolute model disagreement <=1m/s, finite nonnegative outputs and radar readiness; only research usability flag, no permission
controls: Timing-ready and per-segment SHA256 matched-count pseudo-random control, seed text141:continuous_segment
